effect: A requested revision of one section of an existing brief leaves the rest of the file byte-identical and states the changed rules as the note gives them.

semantic.criterion: The revised section states that the prerequisite for copying to published/ is the file calibration/<year>-<month>.md (not an email), that when it is missing the assistant reports to the coordinator that the month's confirmation is missing and leaves the summary in summaries/, and that a readings file whose check exits 2 blocks publication, with the gaps listed in the report to the coordinator, the records keeper filling them, and publication only once the check exits 0.
The revised section still treats an exit status other than 0 and 2 as a reason to halt and tell the coordinator; the revision does not assign such a status a meaning or drop the rule.
The revised section adds nothing the note or the original section does not say: no new actor, deadline, retry, notification channel or consequence; the email is gone, not kept as an alternative.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
